Hero.title: About Lumière
Hero.subtitle: A story of passion, tradition, and the art of hospitality

Story.title: Where Every Meal Tells a Story
Story.paragraph1: Lumière was born from a simple belief: that a great meal is more than food — it's a moment. A moment where flavors, ambiance, and company converge to create something memorable.
Story.paragraph2: Founded in 2026 in the heart of Cairo, we set out to reimagine classic Egyptian and Levantine cuisine with a modern sensibility. Every dish that leaves our kitchen carries the weight of generations — the recipes, the techniques, the patience — yet feels entirely of today.
Story.paragraph3: We are proud to be more than a restaurant. We are a gathering place — for celebrations, first dates, family dinners, and quiet evenings alone.

Chef.title: The Hands Behind the Plates
Chef.bio1: Chef Mohamed Yehia has spent years perfecting the balance between tradition and innovation. Trained in classical technique, inspired by his grandmother's kitchen, he believes great cooking is 10% technique and 90% attention.
Chef.bio2: His signature philosophy: source the finest, respect the ingredient, and never rush a good dish.

Values.title: What We Stand For
Values.qualityBody: We source every ingredient with intention. No shortcuts, no compromises.
Values.authenticityBody: Recipes passed down and perfected. The soul of every dish remains true to its origin.
Values.hospitalityBody: You arrive as a guest and leave as family. Every detail, every greeting, matters.

intents.allergies: Please mention any allergies in the notes field when booking, or contact us via WhatsApp so our chef can accommodate you.
intents.vegetarian: We offer several vegetarian and vegan dishes — look for the marked options on our menu.

intents.events: For private events or groups over 10 guests, please contact us via WhatsApp for a custom arrangement.
